$comment: The pin page (/pin/; /contributors/ redirects here). Not linked from anywhere and kept out of search engines: only the button and the ambassador program exist today. It sketches what The Labs is building toward, from the recognition-system draft (design/research/recognition-system.md). [PLACEHOLDER] marks what's still open.
title: The pin
description: A first look at the pin The Labs is building toward: earned, never bought.

hero.title: A pin that's earned.
hero.lede: A first look at how The Labs hopes to thank people who help in more than one way. It's still a draft, and our first ambassadors will help shape it.
hero.alt: The pin: the orb mark with teal and red cat-eye enamel

open.title: Anyone can pitch in.
open.body: You don't need a title to help. If you improve a guide, a flyer, or a bit of code, you're a contributor, and we'll credit you by name. No application needed.

tiers.title: A button for what you do.
tiers.lede: Each role at The Labs will have its own button. The Ambassador button is the first.

items.label: When you start
items.title: The button
items.body: Once you're trained for a role, your coordinator or the role's lead gives you its button.

tiers.buttonAlt: A role button: the orb mark on ink, ringed in white

ladder.title: One pin, with room to grow.
ladder.lede: Everyone who earns the pin wears the same one. As you take on more, a thin metal plate goes behind it.

ranks.name: Reviewer
ranks.body: For someone who's practised two roles, with two pin holders vouching for them. Reviewers help look over new work in the roles they know.

ranks.name: Committer
ranks.body: For someone who's helped across every main area of The Labs. Committers help approve work, within guidelines the board sets.

ranks.name: Maintainer
ranks.body: For people who help guide where an area is heading. Suggested by other Maintainers and confirmed by the board.

ladder.metal: Brass for work in your region, and silver for work across the whole network.

alt.committer: The pin on one metal backing plate
alt.maintainer: The pin on two stacked metal backing plates

membership.title: Two ways to belong.
membership.lede: You can support The Labs, or earn your place by helping out. They're separate, and you're welcome to do both.

doors.name: Supporting Member
doors.how: A small yearly contribution, on a sliding scale. If money's tight, just ask and we'll waive it, no questions asked.
doors.gets: A SUPPORTING MEMBER button, a place on the register (our record of members), and invitations to events.
doors.note: Dues: [PLACEHOLDER: $X a year, $75 at most]. Coming soon.

doors.name: Contributing Member
doors.how: Earned by helping, starting with the pin.
doors.gets: The pin, a place on the register, and a voice in the work you know best.

rules: Contributions will help The Labs, but they'll never buy a pin or a vote.
You won't need to pay to earn the pin, and earning the pin will never ask you to pay.

ceremony.title: A moment to celebrate.
ceremony.lede: Once your pin is recorded, we celebrate you at the next regional gathering, held every few months. [PLACEHOLDER: the details are still a draft.]

moments.label: Your name
moments.body: We say your name, and the roles you've practised.

moments.label: Your sponsors
moments.body: The two people who vouched for you pin it on.

moments.label: A few words
moments.body: They share a sentence about what you did.

moments.label: The register
moments.body: Your pin's number matches your entry, for good.

seats.title: Your pin is yours to keep.

items.title: It's for life.
items.body: The pin records what you've done, and it stays with you.

items.title: Roles come and go.
items.body: Each Lab keeps as many active roles as the work needs. Our records show who's active right now.

items.title: Step back whenever you need to.
items.body: You keep your pin and your title, and you're welcome back in any open role.

seats.exception: The only exception is a serious breach of our Code of Conduct.

register.title: Our pin holders.
register.empty: No one yet. The first pins will be given out at our next regional gathering.
register.label: The register, {n} entries

items.a: No. The pin can only be earned. If you'd like to support The Labs with money, you can become a Supporting Member instead.
No. It's our community's way of saying thank you for the work you've done.

items.q: What's the difference between brass and silver?
items.a: Brass is for work in your region. Silver is for work across the whole network.

items.q: What if I need to step back?
items.a: That's fine. You keep your pin, and you're always welcome back.

join.title: Start with one button.
join.lede: Most people begin as an ambassador. It takes about ten minutes to join.

footer.renders: Images of the button and pin are 3D renders, not photos. The plates are sketches.
footer.draft: [PLACEHOLDER] A draft, not yet approved by the board.
